scripts.text:
[Necko]
I'm sorry. Necko's store is...
Oh? Who's this?
Pukakakakakakakakakaka!!!
Long time no see!
How are you?
Nice to see you again!!
Anything new?
Wow~ I'm so glad to see you!
You! Stop by once in a while!
I might forget what you look like!
Pukakakakakakakakaka!!!
Very very nice to see you!!
It's so nice to see you like this!
Come to Alberta often!
Killing two birds with one stone!!
I get to see you, and shout also!!
How much better can it get!!!
Keuhahahahahahahaha!!
Pukakakakakakakakakaka!!!
Ppyakikakikakakakakakakaka!!
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
抱歉，涅科的店...
哦？谁来了？
Pukakakakakakakakakaka!!!
好久不见！
最近怎么样？
又见到你真高兴！！
有什么新鲜事？
哇~太开心了！
你呀，偶尔也过来转转！
不然我都快忘了你长什么样了！
Pukakakakakakakakaka!!!
真是太、太高兴了！！
能这样再见面，真好！
常来艾尔贝塔啊！
一举两得！！
既见着你，又能放声喊！！
还有比这更棒的吗！！！
Keuhahahahahahahaha!!
Pukakakakakakakakakaka!!!
Ppyakikakikakakakakakakaka!!

scripts.text:
[Necko]
Oh, did you come because
you are infatuated with my voice?
My voice is loud, isn't it!
considering you can hear it from a distance.
And also.
(looks around)
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
哦，被我的嗓音迷住了？
嗓门够响吧，离那么远都听得见！
而且啊...
（四下张望）

scripts.text:
[Necko]
My voice isn't just loud!
!
Once you are about a level 15 merchant
I will tell you the secret!
Then, come again!!!
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
我的声音可不只是响亮！！
等你当商人练到15级，就告诉你秘密！
到时候再来！！！

scripts.text:
[Necko]
Uahahahahahahahahahahahaha!
Kyukwakakakakakakakakakaka!
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
Uahahahahahahahahahahahaha!
Kyukwakakakakakakakakakaka!

scripts.text:
[Necko]
Oh! You!
You are qualified to learn how to shout!
Learn how to shout with my help.
Would you like to learn Crazy Uproar?
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
哦，是你！
可以学怎么喊了！
我来教你，想学大声呐喊吗？

scripts.text: Yes!!!!
scripts.translation: 我要学

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: What is that?
scripts.translation: 那是什么？

scripts.text:
[Necko]
Ahahahahaha!! Good!!!
That's the spirit!
Here we go!
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
Ahahahahaha!! 好！！！
就是这股劲儿！
开始！

scripts.text:
[Necko]
You have learned Crazy Uproar!!
Shout as much as you wish!
Hahahahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
学会大声呐喊了！！
尽情喊吧！
Hahahahahahaha!

scripts.text:
[Necko]
Eh... ok.
Pooooh...
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
呃...好吧。
Pooooh...

scripts.text:
[Necko]
Crazy Uproar uses your loud voice
to boost battle spirit
With 8 SP, you get an additional
4 STR for 5 minutes!!!!!
If you use it repeatedly
it is 5 minutes from that point on.
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
大声呐喊靠响亮的声音振奋斗志。
消耗8 SP，力量提高4点，持续5分钟！！！！！
再次使用，就从那一刻重新计算5分钟。

scripts.text:
[Necko]
Stay casual in everyday life,
and when you need to fight
it will gather your spirit.
Very useful, I must say!!!!
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
平时轻轻松松，打起仗来，就靠它凝聚斗志。
好用得很！！！！

scripts.text:
[Necko]
Oh, were you charmed 
by my voice?
Indeed, my voice is loud!
You can hear it from so far away.
And also.
(looks around)
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
哦，被我的嗓音迷住了？
那当然，我嗓门可大了，隔老远都听得见！
而且啊...
（四下张望）

scripts.text:
[Necko]
My voice isn't JUST loud!
I have learned the skill
that lets me shout..
The Crazy Uproar skill!
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
我的声音可不只是响亮！
我学过专门用来呐喊的绝技...大声呐喊！

scripts.text:
[Necko]
Crazy Uproar uses your loud voice
to boost battle spirit
With 8 sp, you get an additional
4 STR for 5 minutes!!!!!
If you use it repeatedly
it is 5 minutes from that point.
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
大声呐喊靠响亮的声音振奋斗志。
消耗8 SP，力量提高4点，持续5分钟！！！！！
再次使用，就从那一刻重新计算5分钟。

scripts.text:
[Necko]
Stay casual in everyday life,
but shout to gather more
strength when you fight.
It is very useful!!!!
To learn this skill, you first need
to learn the essentials of sound!!!
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
平时轻轻松松，战斗时放声呐喊，就能凝聚更多力量。
好用得很！！！！
想学这招，先得懂声音的基本功！！！

scripts.text:
[Necko]
You can learn this in Payon
from a singer with just a loud voice
You can take lessons from him!
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
斐扬有个嗓门特别大的歌手，可以教你。
找他上课就行！

scripts.text:
[Necko]
But that person died!
So you can't learn it anymore!
Hahahahahahahaha!!!!
..............................
...Aww you look disappointed?
Do you want to learn Crazy Uproar?
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
不过，那人已经死了！
没处学啦！
Hahahahahahahaha!!!!
...
...哎呀，失望了？
想学大声呐喊吗？

scripts.text:
[Necko]
Hmm... Shall I teach you?
If you really want it, that is.
First, I must scorch the vocal cords.
There are some things needed to do so.
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
嗯...真想学的话，我来教你？
先得烧灼声带，为此要准备点东西。

scripts.text:
[Necko]
7 Pearls, 1 bottle of Banana Juice,
and 50 mushroom spores!
Then I'll scorch your vocal chord!
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
珍珠7颗
香蕉汁1瓶
香菇芽孢50个
带齐了，就来烧灼声带！

scripts.text:
[Necko]
See you when you are ready!
I shall prepare my throat for then as well!!
Bboowuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuh~~~!!
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
准备好了再来！
我也先养好嗓子！！
Bboowuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuh~~~!!

scripts.text:
[Necko]
Necko's store is closed right now.
come again later. Hehe~
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
涅科的店铺现在关门了。
请稍后再来。嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[!?]
Muahahahahahahahahahahahaha!!
Pukakakakakakakakakakakakaka!
scripts.translation:
[！？]
Muahahahahahahahahahahahaha!!
Pukakakakakakakakakakakakaka!

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
Mmm? I was wondering who was making all
the raucus carrying around a cart.
It was you.
Yes, I remember you.
what do you think? The new cart..good, yeah?
scripts.translation:
[查尔隆]
嗯？我还在想，谁推着车这么吵，原来是你。
对，记得你。
新手推车怎么样...不错吧？

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
Enjoy life.
Life isn't just simply moving
forward..Slowly, looking around,
dragging a heavy cart is
the way us merchants live.
Then see you next time.
scripts.translation:
[查尔隆]
好好享受生活吧。
人生可不只是闷头赶路...慢慢走，看看四周，拖着沉甸甸的手推车，这才是咱们商人的日子。
那就下回见。

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
Be healthy~
scripts.translation:
[查尔隆]
保重身体~

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
Nice to see you fellow merchant
If I remember correctly,
you're that famous merchant
these days.
scripts.translation:
[查尔隆]
同行，见到你真高兴。
要没记错，你就是近来很有名的那个商人吧。

scripts.text:
But your cart doesn't
seem to fit your fame.
How pitiful.
scripts.translation:
可这手推车，似乎配不上你的名气啊。
真寒碜。

scripts.text: That's why I came here.
scripts.translation: 所以我才来这里

scripts.text: What about my cart?
scripts.translation: 手推车怎么了

scripts.text: Two pairs is pitiful?
scripts.translation: 两对轮子很寒碜吗

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
Haha! Ok, ok!
With the things you brought
I will change your cart.
scripts.translation:
[查尔隆]
哈哈，好好好！
就拿你带来的东西，给手推车换个样。

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
Congratulations.
You can choose a cart
according to your taste.
And now you don't even need
me to help you. All you
need is some SP.
scripts.translation:
[查尔隆]
恭喜！
今后能按喜好挑手推车了，不用再找我，花点SP就行。

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
Convenient, don't you think?
Oh and one more thing!
Each time you level, you can
have a new different cart
So work hard.
scripts.translation:
[查尔隆]
方便吧？
哦，还有，随着等级提升，能换的新款手推车也会增加，加油练吧。

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
But anyways, it looks very nice on you!
Hahaha! Have a nice day!
scripts.translation:
[查尔隆]
总之，这款可真衬你！
哈哈，祝你今天愉快！

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
Mmm... It's true that I
change carts but...
In order to do so, I need
some materials to use.
scripts.translation:
[查尔隆]
嗯...我是能改装手推车，不过得有材料。

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
50 Trunks.
10 Iron.
20 Animal Skins.
I need at least these things
to change your cart.
scripts.translation:
[查尔隆]
树干50个
铁10个
动物外皮20个
至少得有这些，才能改装手推车。

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
So come see me when you
have prepared everything.
scripts.translation:
[查尔隆]
所以等你准备好一切再来找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
Oh no, you don't know at all?(changes tone)
A new way to show off a merchant's ego!
An expression of an excellent brain!
Change Cart is a skill that
makes a merchant stand out!
scripts.translation:
[查尔隆]
哎呀，完全不知道？（换了个语气）
彰显商人自我的新方式，聪明头脑的体现！
改装手推车，让商人与众不同！

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
A fun skill that allows you to
use a cart according to your
level with only 40 SP!
scripts.translation:
[查尔隆]
这招很有趣，只消耗40 SP，就能按等级换用不同的手推车！

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
That is Change Cart!
A basic skill for any merchant.
I'll teach you how to make
one so watch carefully, and
do exactly what I do to make
your own in the future!
scripts.translation:
[查尔隆]
这就是改装手推车，商人的基本本领。
我会示范，仔细看，照着做，以后就能自己改了！

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
But, since it's the first time
you need to prepare some materials.
50 Trunks!
10 Iron!
20 Animal skins!
-bring these please!
scripts.translation:
[查尔隆]
不过头一回，得先备点材料：
树干50个
铁10个
动物外皮20个
请把这些带来！

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
All we have to do is
make one using those materials,
so come back when you are ready.
Ok?
scripts.translation:
[查尔隆]
拿这些材料做一辆就行，准备好再来，明白吗？

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
...it's not 'CARD'!
scripts.translation:
[查尔隆]
...不是“卡片”！

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
Welcome young one.
Is selling fun? I am the
merchant Charlron. I have been
doing some research about.
carts recently.
scripts.translation:
[查尔隆]
欢迎啊，年轻人。
生意做得有趣吗？
我是商人查尔隆，最近正在研究手推车。

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
Aren't you tired of that cart?
Come to me if you want to
change your cart. I'll do a good job.
But, there are some conditions.
scripts.translation:
[查尔隆]
这手推车看腻了？
想换造型，尽管来找我，保证满意。
不过得满足些条件。

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
I'm a pretty famous merchant,
so I don't really deal with beginners.
Once you are level 30
I may consider establishing
a deal with you.
scripts.translation:
[查尔隆]
我也是有名的商人，不跟新手做生意。
等你到30级，再考虑跟你谈。

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
I am a merchant that
deals with many things, Charlron.
If you ever find anything interesting
come back and try to 
negotiate a deal with me.
scripts.translation:
[查尔隆]
我是查尔隆，什么都经营些的商人。
找到有趣的东西，就来找我谈谈生意。

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Ah, long time no see!
Ohh, the red marks on your cart.
They must be the marks of 'it'...
Seems like I have taught you the skill correctly!
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
啊，好久不见！
哦，手推车上的红印子，一定是“那个”留下的吧...
看来我这招教得不错！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
You have blood like mine in you!
Mmm! After all!!
I'm happy! Scratch my back!
Here! Hurry!
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
你跟我流着一样的血！
嗯，果然！！
真高兴，帮我挠挠背！
这儿，快点！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Ooh. You have a firm body
for a merchant. You must be
very good a carrying things!?
Mmm you should be able to learn
Cart Revolution!
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
哦，身为商人，身子倒很结实，肯定很会搬东西吧？！
嗯，学手推车攻击应该没问题！

scripts.text: Hey~ that's why I came.
scripts.translation: 嘿~ 这就是我来找你的原因

scripts.text: What's that?
scripts.translation: 那是什么？

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Hoho!
Got it! I shall teach you
Cart Revolution!
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
呵呵！明白了！
我来教你手推车攻击！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Ah, such a nice day!
I shall reward those who
eagerly swing their carts!
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
啊，天气真好！
肯卖力挥舞手推车的人，值得奖励！

scripts.text:
Now you can use Cart Revolution
I expect you to make merchants
famous by using this amazing
destruction power. Muahahahahaha!!!
scripts.translation:
好了，手推车攻击学会了。
用这惊人的破坏力，让咱们商人扬名天下吧。
Muahahahahaha!!!

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Have a great day!!
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
祝你今天愉快！！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Ooh!
It's banana juice!
Thank you very much!
...............Kaah!
Very refreshing! Thank you! Goodbye!
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
哦，是香蕉汁！
太感谢了！
...Kaah!
真爽口！
谢谢，再见！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Hmm?
You didn't leave yet?
Ah! You are still attached
to Cart Revolution!
Ok then. Considering you brought
the Banana Juice, I'll teach you.
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
嗯？还没走？
啊，还惦记手推车攻击呢！
看在香蕉汁的分上，我就教你。

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
It's not hard to teach you
Cart Revolution, but I need you to prepare
the materials to modify your cart.
The items I need are..
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
教手推车攻击不难，可得先准备改装手推车的材料。
需要这些...

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
First I need 20 Irons to make the cart
durable. Then 30 Sticky Mucus to absorb
the shock.
And about 20 Fly Wings and 5 Tentacles?
And 2 bottles of Grape Juice for me!
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
先要铁20个，加固车身；再用粘稠液体30个，缓冲震动。
然后大概还要苍蝇翅膀20个、触手5个？
还有给我喝的葡萄汁2瓶！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Just bring those.
I'm not saying ONLY 30 or 20.
It depends on my condition!
Hahahaha!
I'll be waiting. Then byebye~
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
带这些来吧。
我可没说只要30个、20个，具体多少得看我状态！
Hahahaha!
等你哦，拜拜~

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Mmm!
Nothing can be done without a refreshing drink!
How about starting a conversation
with at least a bottle of Banana Juice?
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
嗯，没杯清爽的饮料，什么也干不了！
至少先拿瓶香蕉汁，再开口谈吧？

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Mmm that's good!
Great! I shall teach you
...Cart Revolution!
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
嗯，不错！
好，这就教你...手推车攻击！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Ah, such a nice day!
I shall reward those who
eagerly swing their carts!
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
啊，天气真好！
肯卖力挥舞手推车的人，值得奖励！

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
好了，手推车攻击学会了。

Muahahahahaha!!!

scripts.text:

Have a good day!!
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
祝你今天愉快！！

scripts.text:

Ooh!
It's banana juice!
Thanks a lot!
...............Kaaah!
Very good! Thank you! Good-bye!
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
哦，是香蕉汁！
太感谢了！
...Kaaah!
真不错！
谢谢，再见！

scripts.text:

Mmm?
You didn't leave yet?
Ah! You're still attached

Ok then. Considering you brought
the banana juice, I'll teach you.
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
嗯？还没走？
啊，还惦记手推车攻击呢！
看在香蕉汁的分上，我就教你。

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
It's not hard to teach you
Cart Revolution, but I need you to prepare
the materials to modify your cart.
The items I need are..
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
教手推车攻击不难，可得先准备改装手推车的材料。
需要这些...

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
First I need 20 Irons to make the cart
durable. Then 30 Sticky Mucus to absorb

And about 20 Fly Wings and 5 Tentacles?
And 2 bottles of Grape Juice for me!
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
先要铁20个，加固车身；再用粘稠液体30个，缓冲震动。
然后大概还要苍蝇翅膀20个、触手5个？
还有给我喝的葡萄汁2瓶！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Bring these to me.
But that doesn't mean I want only 30 and 20.
It all depends on my condition!
Just bring me these for now.
Hahahaha!
I'm looking forward to it. Good bye then~
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
带这些来吧。
不过我可没说只要30个、20个，具体多少得看我状态！
先弄来再说。
Hahahaha!
等着你，那就再见~

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Mmm!
Nothing's free nowadays!
How about trying to start a conversation
by offering a bottle of Banana Juice or something?
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
嗯，如今哪有白拿的好处！
先拿瓶香蕉汁什么的来，再开口谈吧？

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Mmm that's good!
Great! I shall teach you
...Cart Revolution!
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
嗯，不错！
好，这就教你...手推车攻击！

啊，天气真好！
肯卖力挥舞手推车的人，值得奖励！

Muahahahahaha!!!

Have a good day!!
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
祝你今天愉快！！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Ooh!
It's Banana Juice!
Thanks a lot!
...............Kaaah!
Very good! Thank you! Good-bye!
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
哦，是香蕉汁！
太感谢了！
...Kaaah!
真不错！
谢谢，再见！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Mmm?
You didn't leave yet?
Ah! You're still attached
to Cart Revolution!
Ok then. Considering you brought
the banana juice, I'll teach you.
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
嗯？还没走？
啊，还惦记手推车攻击呢！
看在香蕉汁的分上，我就教你。

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
It's not hard to teach you
Cart Revolution, but I need you to prepare
the materials to modify your cart.
The items I need are..
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
教手推车攻击不难，可得先准备改装手推车的材料。
需要这些...

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
First I need 20 Irons to make the cart
durable. Then 30 Sticky Mucus to absorb
the shock.
And about 20 Fly Wings and 5 Tentacles?
And 2 bottles of Grape Juice for me!
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
先要铁20个，加固车身；再用粘稠液体30个，缓冲震动。
然后大概还要苍蝇翅膀20个、触手5个？
还有给我喝的葡萄汁2瓶！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Just bring those.
I'm not saying ONLY 30 or 20.
It depends on my condition!
Hahahaha!
I'll be waiting. Then byebye~
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
带这些来吧。
我可没说只要30个、20个，具体多少得看我状态！
Hahahaha!
等你哦，拜拜~

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Mmm!
Nothing can be done without a refreshing drink!
How about starting a conversation
with at least a bottle of Banana Juice?
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
嗯，没杯清爽的饮料，什么也干不了！
至少先拿瓶香蕉汁，再开口谈吧？

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
... you don't seem to know
about Cart Revolution.
Ok, I'll tell you a story
I've never told anyone before.
Listen carefully.
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
...看来你不知道手推车攻击。
我讲个从没告诉过别人的故事，仔细听。

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
I did research about a different
way to use the cart.
I tried cooking ramen
and even tried jump-roping.
But none of them were able
to satisfy me.
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
我一直研究，手推车还能怎么用。
试过煮拉面，甚至拿来跳绳，可都不满意。

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
In despair, I wandered
through the fields with my cart.
After wandering dazed day after day..
I met a very strong monster.
Life was in danger!
Why me - a weaponless, armor-less merchant!
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
失望之余，我拖着手推车，在野外游荡。
一连好些天，浑浑噩噩...忽然遇上强大的魔物！
命悬一线！
偏偏我是个没武器、没盔甲的商人！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
I was scared to death.. thinking
and hoping that this wasn't the
last of me. With little hope left
I tried the last thing possible.
I used my cart to hit the monster!
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
我吓坏了...难道就这样完了？
抱着最后一线希望，拼命一试，用手推车砸向魔物！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
The monster died in one hit.
It was then that I realized something.
Carts can become weapons, too!
I finally realized that we can
attack with carts!
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
一击就把魔物打死了。
那一刻，我才明白：手推车也能当武器！
原来，还能用它攻击！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Cart Revolution!
That's the new attack skill I developed.
Using 12 SP you lift your cart
to hit your opponent..
right in the head!
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
手推车攻击！
这就是我创出的新攻击技能。
消耗12 SP，举起手推车，对着敌人脑袋就砸！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
The heavier your cart is, the
stronger you can attack! With one hit,
your opponent will be hurt and
forced to back off!
This is Cart Revolution!
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
手推车越重，攻击越强！
一击就能打伤敌人，逼它后退！
这就是手推车攻击！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Mmm, a young merchant.
You must use carts, too.
Since you need to do business.
But is that all?
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
嗯，年轻的商人，做生意肯定也用手推车吧。
可它只能拿来做生意吗？

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
I did research about a different
way to use the cart.
I tried cooking ramen
and even tried jump-roping.
But none of them were able
to satisfy me.
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
我一直研究，手推车还能怎么用。
试过煮拉面，甚至拿来跳绳，可都不满意。

scripts.text: I know, I know.
scripts.translation: 我知道，我知道

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
...no, what I'm saying is.
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
...不是，我想说的是...

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Would you like to learn this skill?
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
你想学习这个技能吗？

scripts.text: Yes!!
scripts.translation: 我要学

scripts.text: I want to learn sushi skills...
scripts.translation: 我想学寿司技能...

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Ok!
I'll give you special training!
First you need health!
Get yourself to merchant
level 35!
We'll talk after that!
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
好！给你来个特训！
先把身子练结实，商人等级到35级了再谈！

scripts.text:
[Sushi King Gershaun]
Stupid girl!
It's way to early for you to
even put your hands on sushi!
scripts.translation:
[寿司之王格尔肖恩]
笨女孩！
你连碰寿司的资格都还没有呢！

scripts.text:
[Sushi King Gershaun]
Stupid boy!
It's way to early for you to
even put your hands on sushi!
scripts.translation:
[寿司之王格尔肖恩]
笨男孩！
你连碰寿司的资格都还没有呢！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
If it doesn't work, make it work.
If it doesn't work, make it work.
If it doesn't work, make it work.
scripts.translation:
[格尔肖恩]
不行，就想办法做到。
不行，就想办法做到。
不行，就想办法做到。
